share_unavailable.description:
ScorpionTrack can no longer read the share for {name}. Vehicle updates are unavailable.

1. Open ScorpionTrack and check whether the share has expired or been revoked.
2. If you restore access to the same share, go to Settings > Devices & services in Home Assistant and reload its ScorpionTrack entry.
3. If you need a different share, add it as a new ScorpionTrack integration, then remove the old integration.

The repair clears after a successful update or when you remove the affected integration.
